name: linkedin-posts
description: Write LinkedIn posts in your voice, rewrite your profile, and draft messages from the facts and text you supply. Use when you ask “rewrite my profile”, “draft a post in my voice”, or “help me reply to a recruiter”. Paste the relevant text or provide an existing export. You get a draft to review and paste yourself. It can also summarize supplied person or company excerpts for a meeting. Not for account access, live profile searches, sending, publishing, scraping or automated engagement. No account connection or network access.
